open_points.subject: _record_delivery_failure
open_points.text: - _record_delivery_failure: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one new transaction, read the delivery_id and write the failed outcome only through tx.email_deliveries(), and commit exactly once, returning that record; its guard MUST close its transaction exactly once, roll back on failure only while the transaction is still open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level delivery method, call the provider, or change the challenge the record references.
open_points.question: Must the PortalStore contract add the transaction, commit, rollback, close, and email_deliveries operations required by the note, or must the note be changed to use only the declared PortalStore surface?

open_points.subject: _send_delivery_request
open_points.text: - _send_delivery_request: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST send only the typed request through the configured provider and return provider_message_id without logging token or inferring address ownership.

open_points.subject: deliver_email_message
open_points.text: - deliver_email_message: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, insert the pending record only through tx.email_deliveries(), and commit it before the provider is called; it MUST then call the provider with no transaction open, and afterwards open one further transaction to read that delivery_id and write the accepted outcome only through tx.email_deliveries(), committing exactly once. Holding any transaction open across the provider call, and using a legacy transaction-level delivery method, are forbidden.
